what: Grade of the blind test D1-D4 pre-registered in PLAN-amendment-0.3.3.md section 5, on the readings in data/read-d1d3.json. Conductances in MW m^-2 K^-1, slopes s in MW m^-2 K^-2. Excluded means measured G(T2) < 0.85 G_min(T2).
provenance: Worked out by hand on 2026-11-19 from tbc_direct.min_rise_prediction. test_tbc_grade_d.py recomputes every number with tbc_grade_d.run and the commit is made only if all agree within the stated tolerances (0.3 MW for G_min, 0.002 for s). For the full machine output run: python tbc_grade_d.py --read data/read-d1d3.json --meas data/meas-li2022.json --out results/dtest/machine

exploratory_not_preregistered.note: At central readings and with no margin, the two flat interfaces allow an interface-independent T-linear direct channel of at most s = 0.148 (sigma_e(300 K) <= 44.5). Removing that largest allowed channel from Li et al.'s Sample 1 (the sharp Al/Si interface) leaves a phonon side that still rises steeply.
exploratory_not_preregistered.cheng_ep_share_note: G(300)/G_ep(300) = 346/1454.9 = 24 % of the Al/sapphire resistance sits in the Al electron-phonon step under our bulk law; Cheng et al. independently estimate 'about 20%'.
